messages:
incident-bot: ALERT  • elevated 5xx rate detected in prod us-east-1 (gateway + backend timeouts). 10m aggregate error rate 7% (baseline 0.5%). auto-pager triggered for oncall.

alice (oncall): saw it, joining. which services are the top offenders?

ben (sre): gateway (ingress-proxy) 502/504 spike, then downstream runtime RPC errors to model-host-pool. traces are sparse — lots of requests with no trace-id. logs show repeated `upstream reset` and `kv-cache miss` churn.

carla (eng-runtime): confirming, model-hosts show increased connection resets around 15:12 UTC — likely transient network flaps _or_ an overloaded threadpool after the deploy at 14:45. can we confirm deploys?

danny (eng-platform): there was a small runtime config change at 14:44 rolling back a connection keepalive tweak. rollback is queued but slow due to canary.

alice (oncall): immediate customer impact? eva?

eva (support): a handful of paying customers reported 500s for generation endpoints (mainly chat & embeddings) starting ~15:10. CS ticket volume rising.

ben (sre): priority: (1) reduce customer-facing 5xx quickly, (2) restore trace linkage for postmortem. We have observability gap: many requests reach ingress but lose request-id/from-proxy headers before runtime, so traces never link.

alice (oncall): propose stopgap steps: - bump log-level on runtime to DEBUG for ingress-handshake, - enable request-id passthrough at proxy, - temporarily route a small fraction to a healthy pool without the new config. Also start live trace sampling for all requests for 10m. Any objections?

carla (eng-runtime): agree. I can flip log-level and enable trace-sidecar sampling. Will also patch runtime to inject x-request-id if missing.

ben (sre): I'll patch the ingress config to preserve x-request-id and to increase proxy read timeout to 20s (from 8s) to reduce 504s while we investigate.

alice (oncall): do it. Also, add a short runbook note for customers impacted and link to the status page. pager-bot, please notify execs and escalate if >10% customers impacted.

pager-bot: Escalation rule evaluated: current affected customers = 6 (< escalation threshold). Notifying ops-leads and eng-leads.

carla (eng-runtime): applying temporary runtime config (non-disruptive):

```
# kubectl patch to enable trace sampling & request-id shim
kubectl -n runtime patch deployment runtime-service --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"runtime/trace-sampling":"100%","runtime/inject-request-id":"true"}}}}}'
```

carla (eng-runtime): patch applied. logging increased for ingress-handshake. will tail for 2 mins.

ben (sre): ingress patch (preserve headers + timeout):

```
kubectl -n ingress patch configmap envoy-config --patch '{"data":{"proxy_read_timeout":"20s","preserve_x_request_id":"true"}}'
kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deploy/ingress-proxy
```

ben (sre): rolled restart started. watch for restart thrash.

alice (oncall): while that rolls, can we divert new traffic to the older stable runtime pool? we need immediate customer relief.

danny (eng-platform): adding 15% traffic to stable pool via routing shim. will do a gradual 5% step to 15% over 2 mins.

```
# routing change
curl -X POST "https://controlplane/api/v1/route/update" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL" -d '{"route":"/generate","fallback_pool":"runtime-stable","weight":15}'
```

carla (eng-runtime): seeing request-ids now in runtime logs for many requests. trace sampling spiking — good. initial error rate dropping from 7% -> 3.2% after route shift.

eva (support): CS reporting fewer new tickets, some customers confirm partial relief.

ben (sre): watch: some model-hosts still have elevated error counts. I'm seeing upstream `connection reset by peer` on a subset of hosts. Could be socket exhaustion. Patch to bump ulimit/socket backlog on the host agent?

carla (eng-runtime): I can push a short-lived hotfix to the host agent to increase net.core.somaxconn and keepalive params. Patching rolling one host at a time.

alice (oncall): acknowledge — do that. Also capture a sampling of full request+response payloads for one minute for debugging (PII safe-list will be respected). Add a note in runbook that only metadata and non-sensitive diagnostics are collected, and that it's time-limited.

carla (eng-runtime): enabling debug capture for 60s: `obsctl capture --service runtime-service --duration 60s --fields request_headers,response_status,trace_id`

ben (sre): after these changes, 5xx down to 1.1% in 10m window. ingress restarts completed fine.

alice (oncall): good. start a short incident bridge for 30m to monitor and gather artifacts. I'll open the bridge now and invite eng-runtime, eng-platform, SRE, and support.

alice (oncall): bridge open: https://meet.redwood/bridges/1758502468

pager-bot: Bridge creation recorded. Notifying bridge participants.

danny (eng-platform): note for postmortem: rollback of the 14:44 keepalive change reduced capacity headroom; combined with connection churn led to partial socket exhaustion. Also gap in propagation of x-request-id caused trace-blackhole. We should add a pre-deploy telemetry check for header-preservation.

eva (support): CS will prepare customer impact summary: list of customers affected, start/end times, and mitigation steps. ETA 45m.

alice (oncall): temporary mitigations in place: routing shift, ingress header preserve, runtime request-id shim, increased probe timeouts, host net tweaks, trace sampling + capture. Current status: errors stabilized ~1% and trending down.

ben (sre): leaving a quick checklist/todo in thread for post-incident: [ ] revert routing weight back gradually after stability confirmed, [ ] permanent fix to keepalive config and host socket param tuning, [ ] add CI check for header roundtrip, [ ] add more conservative default proxy read timeout, [ ] formal postmortem.

carla (eng-runtime): will follow up with PR for request-id propagation test and add runtime health metric for socket_backlog.

alice (oncall): handing off to ben and carla for next 2 hours of mitigation and postmortem prep. I'll remain on-call but stepping out for a quick break. If error rate increases >2% or customer impact >10 customers, re-page.

ben (sre): taking incident lead. will gather logs/traces and start timeline. tagging incident as sev2 for now.

carla (eng-runtime): noted. capturing final debug bundle and will upload to incident artifacts.

alice (oncall): thanks team. quick retrospective note: we need better end-to-end header guarantees and a short emergency runbook to re-route traffic to stable pools automatically when deploy causes upstream flakiness. Add to action items.

eva (support): prep draft customer comms for legal & comms review.

pager-bot: Incident updated: lead=ben (sre), severity=sev2, status=mitigated->monitoring.

ben (sre): final: will keep bridge open for 30m, then close and move to postmortem. uploading trace samples and logs to /incidents/1758502468/artifacts.

alice (oncall): closing live mitigation update in thread. follow-ups tracked in issue INF-4321.

carla (eng-runtime): thanks.

incident-bot: NOTE: alert cleared in us-east-1. New alert rate below threshold.
